title: Basket Bros
description: Fast-paced retro 1-on-1 basketball action with wild dunks, step-back 3-pointers, and high-flying street court rivalries. Choose your bro and dominate the court!
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to run and leap
Space or L to shoot the ball or steal
Time your jump at the rim for devastating slam dunks

title: Neon Snake Arcade
description: Navigate the hyper-speed neon serpent across the digital grid. Collect radiant energy orbs, boost your score multiplier, and avoid wall collision.
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to navigate
Space to restart on game over
Touch D-Pad on mobile

title: Cosmic Rebel: Starfighter
description: Take control of an experimental starfighter. Vaporize incoming alien armada waves, dodge heavy photon torpedoes, and recharge your energy shields.
controls: Arrow Keys / WASD to fly
Space to fire double laser cannons
Touch & drag on mobile

title: Cyber Rooftop Runner
description: Sprint endlessly across glowing skyscraper rooftops. Perform precision double jumps over sheer drops, leap over barrier pylons, and gather cyber crystals.
controls: Space / Up Arrow to Jump
Double tap for Double Jump
Tap screen on mobile

title: 2048 Neon Pulse
description: The quintessential mathematical slider puzzle enhanced with smooth neon animations. Merge identical numbers, calculate future moves, and forge the legendary 2048 tile.
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to slide
Swipe in any direction on mobile
New Game button to reset

title: Neon Breakout
description: High-octane brick breaking classic. Angle the high-velocity energy sphere off your deflector paddle to shatter multi-tier colored light barriers.
controls: Move Mouse or A/D to steer paddle
Touch and drag paddle on mobile
3 Lives per round

title: Cyber Minesweeper
description: Deduction and nerve testing in a cybernetic grid. Flag suspected explosive charges, uncover clean tiles using numerical hints, and clear the entire grid safely.
controls: Left Click to reveal safe tile
Right Click or Flag Mode to place flag
Smiley Face to restart

title: Cyber Pong 1v1
description: Compete against an adaptive neural AI opponent in retro cyber tennis. Add spin to your paddle deflections to outmaneuver the AI. First to 7 points takes victory.
controls: Move Mouse / W/S to move paddle
Touch drag vertically on mobile
First to 7 wins

title: Pixel Flight: Flappy Wings
description: Test your timing and patience in the ultimate one-tap obstacle flight game. Tap rhythmically to keep altitude and pass cleanly through narrow neon gates.
controls: Space, Up Arrow, or Click to flap
Tap anywhere on mobile
Score increases per pipe passed
